verdict.rationale: Microsoft Teams is a SaaS collaboration platform, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server for Teams. The Graph API, webhooks, and the Agents Toolkit CLI are adjacent developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
